title: Climate Change Adaptation Strategy and Action Plan (2024–2030)
organization: Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change / Presidency of Climate Change
geographic_coverage: Türkiye; urban assessments name cities in the Mediterranean, Black Sea, Central Anatolia and Southeastern Anatolia; water assessment covers provinces
temporal_coverage: Strategy 2024–2030; assessment method covers 81 provinces, a 1990–2019 current period and 2021–2100 projections under RCP4.5 and RCP8.5.
methodology: Provincial and urban vulnerability/risk assessments; national method uses current and future climate periods.
limitations: The cited local results do not identify a scenario or assessment period; urban infrastructure data are incomplete and city-wide conclusions may mislead.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: Türkiye
geographic_coverage: Türkiye; Şanlıurfa, Mardin, Antalya, Adana, Hatay and Istanbul subregion
temporal_coverage: Published June 2022; cited wildfire land-burned averages cover 2011–2021; flood poverty estimates use a 200-year return-period case.
methodology: CCDR analytical estimates draw on referenced household, disaster-risk and poverty analyses.
limitations: Publication is dated June 2022 and underlying data vintages vary; the 200-year flood is a modeled case, not a dated event.

title: Decent and Sustainable Job Opportunities for Refugees and Host Communities in Turkish Textile Sector
geographic_coverage: Türkiye; Istanbul and major southeastern cities discussed; field-work locations listed include Gaziantep, Hatay, Mersin, Adana, Kilis, Şanlıurfa, Mardin, İzmir and İstanbul
temporal_coverage: Project dates are November 2022–January 2025; the page does not date its refugee-population counts.
methodology: UNDP page on a Türkiye refugee-host textile employment project.
limitations: Population counts are undated; the project completed in January 2025 without an outcome evaluation.

title: World Bank Approves $600 million for Türkiye to Build Resilience Against Floods and Drought
geographic_coverage: Türkiye; North Aegean, East Black Sea, Kızılırmak, Büyük Menderes, West Mediterranean, East Mediterranean, West Black Sea and Ceyhan basins
temporal_coverage: June 2024 approval announcement and planned project components; it does not report implementation results.
methodology: World Bank approval announcement summarizing project components, target basins and intended reach.
limitations: Beneficiary figures and activities are targets at approval, not completed results; the release gives no local implementation schedule.

title: World Bank and Government of Türkiye Kickoff a $400 Million Project to Make the Country’s Forests More Resilient
geographic_coverage: Türkiye; 2021 wildfires in southern and western regions; project focus is 14 unnamed highest-risk provinces
temporal_coverage: 2021 wildfire impacts and May 2024 project launch.
methodology: World Bank announcement summarizing 2021 wildfire impacts and the planned forest-resilience project.
limitations: The release gives broad regions, not the 14 province names, and does not attribute the specific 2021 fires to climate change.

title: The Closing Event of the ‘Enhancing Adaptation Action in Türkiye’ Project was held on 3 October 2025
organization: EU IPA Environment and Climate Programme; implemented with Türkiye’s Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change and UNDP Türkiye
geographic_coverage: Türkiye; pilot provinces Samsun, Sakarya, Muğla and Konya; awareness activities in 20 cities, not named
temporal_coverage: Project implementation October 2019–October 2025; local plans cover 2025–2030.
methodology: Project close-out page reports outputs from a six-year EU-funded ministry/UNDP adaptation project.
limitations: The site states content is the sole responsibility of Frankfurt School and may not reflect government or EU positions; reported outputs are not independent impact evaluations.
